title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About the Role

Join a product engineering team building AI-powered software for certification, inspection, and compliance workflows. You will work directly with customer operations and the founders to turn real-world challenges into production-ready systems that improve how this work gets done.

What You'll Do

  • Embed with customer teams to understand how certification, inspection, and compliance processes work in practice.

  • Lead customer calls, write specifications, and build end-to-end solutions across frontend, backend, data models, and AI capabilities.

  • Take ownership of product areas and ship working software to production quickly.

  • Observe users working with your software and iterate based on their feedback.

  • Use judgment to distinguish customer requests that generalize from those that are specific to one workflow.

  • Analyze customer documents and outputs to develop AI-powered workflows for scheduling, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence.

What We're Looking For

  • Three to six years of experience as a full-stack engineer, with a track record of shipping production systems to users.

  • Experience with TypeScript, Python, React, Node.js, SQL, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with AI and machine learning, large language models, or document intelligence.

  • Comfort working closely with customers and translating complex operational processes into robust software.
